blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Aboitiz Power Corp. posted a 13-percent jump in its bottom line from January to September, driven by a stronger electricity generation segment. The group’s net income rose to P26.2 billion from P23.3 billion in the same period last year. Core earnings also climbed 11 percent to P25.5 billion from P23.1 billion. READ: Aboitiz energy startup gears up for expansion Its earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation, and amortization stood at P63.7 billion, up 13 percent from P56.3 billion. The energy giant attributed the improved financial footing to its generation segment, fueled by better power prices and higher contracted capacity. […]...
